_pinned_versions_note: Dependencies pinned to exact versions on 2026-05-14 to prevent supply chain attacks (F-07). Re-pin after auditing new releases before upgrading. hostinger-api-mcp=0.2.1, tailscale-mcp=2026.4.10-1, @supabase/mcp-server-postgrest=0.1.1, postgres-mcp=0.3.0

pmoves-cipher._note: Cipher SSE requires bearer auth when the API token is set (hardened container, post-#2005 recreate). The claude-pmoves launcher injects the token env var; without it the header expands empty and cipher returns 401 (same as before this header existed - no regression).

agent-zero._purpose: Agent Zero orchestrator for cross-agent task dispatch and memory operations.

_pmoves-cipher-legacy-python-wrapper._disabled: Replaced 2026-05-15 with direct SSE to Cipher's native MCP endpoint. The Python wrapper called non-existent /api/memory routes. Kept here commented for rollback; remove in follow-up after SSE validated for 2 weeks.

pmoves-nats-fleet._purpose: Cross-node NATS publish/subscribe to the fleet hub on KVM4-2. Replaces SSH-from-CLI dance for signal dispatch (e.g., claw.task.assign.v1 SPARK cascades). Server code shipped in PR #1490; this is the .claude/mcp.json registration enabling the tools at runtime.

cloudflare._purpose: Cloudflare MCP for Pages deploy + DNS zone management (cataclysmstudios.com). Requires CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN + CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID in env. Added Layer 2.1 of COMBINER pipeline (2026-05-26).

pmoves-4090-web._note: D-Proxy SSE gateway for pmoves_4090_web profile. Requires `make mcp-4090-gateway-start` first. Claude Code skips gracefully if gateway is not running.

huggingface._note: OFFICIAL HuggingFace MCP Server (evalstate/hf-mcp-server). Provides: Model Search, Dataset Search, Spaces/Papers search, Documentation semantic search, Hub repo details, Gradio Space execution. Requires HF_TOKEN for higher rate limits.

pmoves-supabase._purpose: Self-hosted PMOVES Supabase via PostgREST (NOT cloud mcp.supabase.com). Replaces the cloud 'supabase' plugin MCP for data-plane access. apiUrl points at the self-hosted Kong/PostgREST REST endpoint; falls back to local supabase-local Kong :8000 if SUPABASE_REST_URL is unset. PostgREST-based per the 'never raw psql' rule (CATALOG.md canonical http://supabase-kong:8000/rest/v1). Pinned per F-07 supply-chain note above.

comfy._purpose: Official ComfyUI MCP (comfy.org) — exposes the ComfyUI engine over MCP: build/edit/run + save/re-run workflows, search models/nodes/templates, generate image/video/audio/3D. Lets the creator-operator computer-use agent drive workflows via MCP instead of clicking the UI.
comfy._note: This is the HOSTED CLOUD endpoint (drives Comfy's cloud). OAuth sign-in on first use in Claude Code (no key needed). For the SELF-HOSTED fleet ComfyUI (project_creator_comfyui_selfhost), a local ComfyUI-API MCP (community, via ComfyUI /prompt) is a separate follow-up to drive the operator's own instance. Claude Code skips gracefully if not signed in.

supabase-db._purpose: Postgres MCP (crystaldba/postgres-mcp 'Postgres MCP Pro') for the SELF-HOSTED Supabase Postgres — the DDL/RLS/migration sibling of pmoves-supabase. Does what PostgREST CANNOT: run SQL, inspect schema + RLS policies, apply migrations, EXPLAIN/health/index analysis. DELIBERATE, SCOPED EXCEPTION to the 'never raw psql' rule (CATALOG.md): data-plane CRUD still goes through pmoves-supabase (PostgREST); this is for schema/migration/RLS work only (the same class as bootstrap's docker-exec psql).
supabase-db._setup: Set SUPABASE_DB_URI to a HOST-reachable connection string: postgresql://pmoves:<SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD>@<host>:<port>/pmoves (the Supabase CLI stack publishes Postgres on a host port — use localhost/host.docker.internal + that port, NOT the internal 'supabase-db' service name). access-mode=unrestricted enables DDL/DML for migrations/RLS; use --access-mode=restricted for read-only audits.
